newsitem.title: USA: Companies added to S&P MidCap 400 Index.
newsitem.headline: Companies added to S&P MidCap 400 Index.

text.p: The Equity Services Group of Standard & Poor's said on Monday it will make two changes in the S&P MidCap 400 Index this week.

Allegiance Corp will replace Home Shopping Network Inc in the S&P MidCap 400 after close of trading on Thursday and Cytec Industries Inc, currently a component of the S&P SmallCap 600 Index, will replace Loctite Corp after close of trading on Friday.
Cytec Industries will be replaced in the SmallCap 600 by Anixter International Inc.

An 80.1 percent stake in Home Shopping Network is being acquired by Silver King Communications Inc, which is not in an S&P Index. Shareholders of Silver King and Home Shopping are scheduled to vote on the transaction on December 19. Silver King will not be added to the S&P at that time.
Henkel KGaA, a German company, is acquiring the 65 percent of Loctite that it does not already own through a friendly cash tender offer scheduled to expire December 20.

Allegiance Corp, a distributor of medical supplies, was spun off from S&P 500 component Baxter International in September 1996. The company will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Health Care industry in the Health Care economic sector.
Cytec Industries is a manufacturer and marketer of specialty chemicals and materials. The company will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Chemicals industry group in the Basic Materials sector.

Anixter International is a leading distributor of wiring systems and networking and international products used in voice, data, video and electrical power applications. The company will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Communications Equipment industry group in the Technology sector.
